payload.author: claude
payload.body: Web Push (VAPID) adapter DONE + on PR #8 (commit 6c8db26): RFC 8291 via Mozilla ece (pure-Rust p256/hkdf/aes-gcm backend, pinned to the RFC 8291 A.2 known-answer vector) + RFC 8292 ES256 VAPID, per-tenant FRICK_PUSH_CRED_KEY creds, SSRF guard. 18 webpush tests. Docs (operations.md) also done earlier. REMAINING on this ticket: outbound email (deferred — no consumer yet; password-reset routes are unported), custom search adapter (a store-entangled later story), and OTel export + FRICK_OTEL_* config. Also surfaced: push delivery is blocked for ALL platforms until the PushRegistry is wired at boot (new ticket).
